description: Run an evidence-backed resume pipeline and a durable interview system that separates the canonical question bank, practice sets, mock sessions, and real interview debriefs.

tools.name: get_job_search_context
tools.description: Read a bounded slice of Job Hunt HQ state. Defaults to a lightweight summary; use scope plus opaque IDs for exact jobs, resumes, interview sets, questions, sessions, discovery, or paginated catalogs.

scope.description: Bounded context view. Omit for a lightweight index and counts.

practice_attempt_id.description: Exact saved answer ID for scope=practice.

search.description: Question text, category, competency, or tag filter for scope=questions.

limit.description: Catalog page size. scope=interview is additionally capped at 5 full questions per response and returns nextCursor.

tools.name: complete_execution_trace
tools.description: Finish the active Panel execution trace with an explicit outcome summary, final status, and output references after useful structured writes are complete.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

output_refs.description: Opaque IDs, source locators, or short artifact references produced by this run.

error.description: Concise blocking error or unresolved failure when status is failed or partial.

tools.name: save_channel_verification
tools.description: Save the visible-browser access and login result for exactly one recruiting provider in the current Session. CodeShell owns the persistent browser profile; this tool never receives credentials, cookies, or verification codes.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

provider_id.description: Exact built-in or custom provider id from get_job_search_context.providerCatalog.

tools.name: save_jd_intake_results
tools.description: Save explicit recognition outcomes for pasted text, screenshots, PDFs, documents, chat exports, or files from the project JD inbox. Every processed source must become imported, needs_review, duplicate, or failed instead of existing only as a Trace.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_candidate_context
tools.description: Save candidate profile, project evidence, and work history extracted from the active CodeShell project's verified files.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_job_opportunities
tools.description: Save discovered job records through a strict completeness gate. Listing cards and partial descriptions become jobLeads and never count as formal opportunities; only a full JD with substantive responsibilities and requirements enters the triage jobs pool and is written to career-data/jd/jobs/.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: update_application_progress
tools.description: Update one job's triage or application stage, next action, reminder date, and evidence-based progress note while preserving an append-only timeline. Only move an inbox job to saved when the user explicitly expresses interest.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_job_research
tools.description: Save sourced company facts, public review summaries, interview intelligence, risks, and source records for one saved job.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_interview_question_set
tools.description: Save a target-specific practice set derived from one JD or an aggregate of multiple JDs, grounded in verified candidate materials. Questions link into the canonical bank and every recommended answer remains source-backed.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

recommended_answer.description: A practice-ready answer draft using only verified candidate facts. Explicitly mark anything the user still needs to supply.

tools.name: save_interview_question_bank_items
tools.description: Normalize and upsert questions from the current Session, a real interview, or another verified source into the canonical interview question bank. Session, imported, and real-interview items are always forced into the curation inbox; only an explicit user edit can make them practice-ready. Exact and normalized duplicates are merged instead of creating another copy.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_interview_practice_review
tools.description: Optionally save one AI-scored review for an answer that is already stored by the Panel, against either an exact set question or a canonical bank question. The Panel computes the overall score from four dimensions.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

practice_attempt_id.description: Exact saved Panel answer ID. Panel-initiated reviews provide this so a detached Trace can be recovered without scoring the wrong answer.

answer_summary.description: Concise summary of what the candidate actually said; do not invent omitted facts.

optimized_answer.description: Improved practice answer using only verified candidate facts and visibly marking unsupported details.

tools.name: save_mock_interview_session
tools.description: Optionally enrich or stop one mock interview session with an evidence-grounded AI summary, strengths, improvements, and next practice steps. Panel answer progress is stored independently.

tools.name: save_preparation_plan
tools.description: Create or replace the candidate's evidence-grounded preparation plan, classifying profile, evidence, and real skill gaps and adding a learning roadmap only for skill gaps.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_interview_debrief
tools.description: Save one real interview debrief and the evidence-grounded improvements that should feed the next resume or preparation iteration.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

tools.name: save_resume_draft
tools.description: Save a direction-level Base Resume or a JD-specific variant with exact claim evidence plus 3–12 private candidate memory questions. Create the base first; variants must identify both base_resume_id and job_id. Candidate questions never appear in public Markdown or PDF.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

candidate_questions.description: Private memory-jogging questions for the candidate. They do not appear in the public resume or PDF and must target missing ownership, scope, impact, decisions, collaboration, failure, or context facts.

tools.name: save_resume_qa_answer
tools.description: Save the candidate's actual answer to one private resume memory-check question. This updates internal evidence only and never edits the public resume automatically.

trace_id.description: Exact opaque Panel Trace ID from the submitted prompt.

answer.description: Faithful summary of what the candidate actually answered, including uncertainty or a skip reason.

suggested_change.description: Optional resume wording or evidence improvement; it is not applied automatically.
